backgroundNote: No need to wait, we will let you know when it is ready.

intro.title:
Your own voice
in three steps
intro.languageHint: Pick the language you will read in. The reading script comes in that language.
intro.languageFailed: The texts for this language could not be loaded. Try again.

steps.roomBody: The quieter your surroundings, the more clearly Sesly learns your voice.
steps.readTitle: Read a story for about {{target}} seconds
steps.readBody: We will show you a short story text. You need to read for at least {{min}} seconds; a longer recording preserves your accent better.
steps.readyBody: Your recording is usually ready in under a minute. You do not have to wait, we will let you know when it is ready.

intro.freePlan: On the free plan you can record your voice {{voices}} times and listen to {{stories}} stories in your own voice.
intro.freePlanStoryOne: On the free plan you can record your voice {{voices}} times and listen to one story in your own voice.
intro.freePlanOnce: On the free plan you can record your voice once and listen to {{stories}} stories in your own voice.
intro.freePlanOnceOne: On the free plan you can record your voice once and listen to one story in your own voice.

consent.lead: Your voice is your personal data. Read and accept the text before recording.
consent.languageNote: This text is in the language of the voice you will record: {{language}}.
consent.check: I have read the text and I give my explicit consent.
consent.errorTitle: The consent text could not be loaded
consent.errorMessage: We have to show you the consent text before recording. Try again.
consent.closedTitle: Voice recording is closed for now
consent.closedMessage: Stories in your own voice are unavailable for a short while. Try again a little later.

tips.distance: Hold the phone a hand span away from your mouth.
tips.calm: Read naturally and calmly, as you would read a bedtime story.
tips.pauses: Do not stay silent for long, keep reading.

hint.permission: Turn on the microphone permission to start recording.
hint.idle: Tap when you are ready and read. The timer starts when you speak.
hint.awaiting: We are listening. The timer starts when you begin to read.
hint.quiet: Your voice is quiet. Read a little louder or move the phone closer.
hint.loud: Your voice is too loud. Move the phone a little further away.
hint.beforeMin: Read at least {{min}} seconds. Keep reading.
hint.beforeTarget: You can stop now. Your voice comes out better if you reach {{target}} seconds.
hint.afterTarget: That is enough. Keep going if you like, the recording stops by itself at {{max}} seconds.

recording.stopLockedHint: You can stop after reading at least {{min}} seconds.
recording.toastAwaiting: Start reading the text aloud. The timer starts when you speak.
recording.toastTooShort: You need to read at least {{min}} seconds. Keep reading.
recording.permissionBody: To record your voice, turn on the microphone permission in settings.
recording.permissionBodyAsk: We need the microphone permission to record your voice.
recording.configErrorTitle: The recording details could not be loaded
recording.consentMessage: You need to accept the explicit consent text before recording.

leave.title: Leave the recording?
leave.running: The recording is still running. If you leave, it is deleted.
leave.unsent: Your recording has not been sent yet. If you leave, it is deleted.

review.title: Listen to your recording
review.note: For now the recording is only on your phone. It is sent when you tap Create my voice.

processing.title: Your voice is being prepared
processing.body: It usually takes less than a minute.
processing.failedTitle: Your voice could not be prepared
processing.failedMessage: The recording could not be processed. Try reading again.
processing.missingMessage: We cannot follow the status of your voice. Go back and try again.
processing.timeoutTitle: This is taking longer than expected
processing.timeoutMessage: Your voice may still be in preparation. It appears on the My voice tab when it is ready.

success.title: Your voice is ready
success.body: Listen to the sample, then use it in a story.
success.sampleMissing: The voice sample was not found
success.sampleNotReady: The sample could not be prepared for now. You can hear your voice in a story.
